items.summary: CTO review: approve containment-only execution. No new production work, queue work, requeues, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, spending, monetization changes, or external outreach are technically supportable this cycle. Continue only existing measurement, repair-or-close, parked-site verification, legal/security evidence, and period-aligned attribution/cost reconciliation. Preserve aggregate commission as unattributed and keep unsupported revenue, margin, ROI, payback, forecast, and causal-lift claims unknown. Reconsider queue entry only after dated ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, release, deduplication, security, attribution, and measurement evidence is recorded.
